layout.body:
Subject: Photography class
Dear Mr. Clark,
Unfortunately, the photography class you registered for on October 20 has been rescheduled. It will now meet on October 28 at 6:00 P.M. instead of October 26 at 5:00 P.M. Your registration fee will be refunded if you have a scheduling conflict.
Regards,
Emily Rodriguez

questions.stem: When did Mr. Clark register for the class?
questions.analysis: When did Mr. Clark register for the class? nguyên văn dựa vào: the photography class you registered for on October 20 has been rescheduled bạn tồn tại 10 tháng 20 báo hàng ngày của chụp ảnh môn học đã sắp xếp lại (A) On October 20 → Đúng (B) On October 25 → Sai (C) On October 26 → Sai (D) On October 29 → Sai

questions.stem: Why may Mr. Clark receive a refund?

options.A: If he registered for the wrong class
options.B: If he could not attend the class
options.C: If he was dissatisfied with the class

questions.analysis: Why may Mr. Clark receive a refund? nguyên văn dựa vào: Your registration fee will be refunded if you have a scheduling conflict. nếu bạn thời gian xung đột không thể tham gia, phí đăng ký sẽ trả lại (A) If he registered for the wrong class → Sai (B) If he could not attend the class → Đúng (C) If he was dissatisfied with the class → Sai (D) If he rescheduled the class → Sai
